supersedes: The profile-20261003-02 empty Input.insertText hypothesis: the later guarded run observed the expected empty Preferred input before cleanup timed out; the failed boundary was the profile-context RPC.

original_reproduction.observed_boundary: Both owner-row upserts returned HTTP 200. Each following get_user_form_context RPC returned HTTP 403 with PostgreSQL code 42501. After each save, the Preferred input held the expected draft but the form remained dirty with a visible error.
original_reproduction.initial_load_limit: The original runner did not reject an initial Profile error banner, so its T02 blank-profile pass is not valid acceptance evidence.

live_database_read_only_findings.authorization_reason: The function body reads auth.users, users.profiles and users.user_form_profile for caller-supplied p_user_id without an auth.uid() equality check. The frontend D31 migration intentionally revoked authenticated EXECUTE; regranting it would expose another person's profile.
live_database_read_only_findings.post_run_owner_row: One admin profile row; preferred_name NULL; no synthetic Profile save value remained. This proves database cleanup, not side-panel UI restoration.

repair.read_contract: The extension now reads users.user_form_profile through usersDb() with an owner user_id filter, as the frontend's personal form-profile reader does. Missing row, read error and malformed data remain distinct. The server-only RPC remains restricted.
repair.runner_contract: Opening Profile with a visible load error cannot count as ready or pass a blank-profile case.
repair.sibling_census: The removed fetchUserFormContext export had one caller, useUserProfile; no other extension source, test or script consumed the bundled context metadata.
repair.red_guard: Before repair, pnpm test src/lib/supabase/user-profile.read.test.ts failed all three initial cases because the RPC returned permission denied instead of reaching the owner-scoped table read.
repair.green_guard: profile-d94-regression-01: guarded single-worker Vitest, five cases passed; resource final decision valid.
repair.forcing_mutation: A constant Maya profile substituted through forcing-function-tests/plant.py failed the Samir case; plant.py restored identical source bytes.
repair.typecheck: profile-d94-compile-01: guarded pnpm compile passed; resource final decision valid.
repair.native_retest: Pending a fresh CI artifact containing the source fix and independent source review. The old 0.2.177 artifact cannot verify the repair.

remaining_limitation.load_failure_ui: The existing hook surfaces a load error banner but leaves an empty editable Profile form visible. The current fix prevents the restricted-RPC failure in normal reads and makes the native runner reject an error banner; a separate failure-state UI repair or explicit tracked defect remains necessary for a denied direct row read.
remaining_limitation.scope_claim: No full Profile acceptance pass is claimed. The old T02 pass is downgraded because it did not check the error banner.
